title: Libya to face Tunisia twice in November in 2027 AFCON qualifiers
text:
Libya to face Tunisia twice in November in 2027 AFCON qualifiers 
 Skip to content Sport News Africa News · Scores · Fantasy Top stories News Sports Countries Competitions Matches SNA TV Fantasy FR Top stories News Sports Countries Competitions Matches SNA TV Fantasy My SNA Matches & scores All stories Libya to face Tunisia twice in November in 2027 AFCON qualifiers
 The Libyans play in Sfax on 13 November, then host Tunisia in Tripoli on 17 November, in 2027 AFCON qualifying.
 Rieltony LOUBOKO · Author profile · 08/11/2026 08:06 UTC 
 Listen to this story
 Synthetic English voice · 47 s
 Download the MP3 Your browser cannot play this audio. Libya will play Tunisia twice in November, in the third and fourth rounds of qualifying for AFCON 2027. They travel to the Taïeb-Mhiri Stadium in Sfax on Friday 13 November, before hosting the Tunisians at the Tripoli International Stadium on Tuesday 17 November.
 After two rounds, Libya have one point, compared with two for Tunisia and Botswana. Uganda lead Group H with four points. Already qualified as hosts, they leave just one place to be won by the other three teams in the group.
